text:
sam.sales: FinNova wants a short POC (2 weeks) and insisted any customer metadata/operation logs must remain inside Canada. They asked if we can do a CA-only pin for the POC, support BYOK (they prefer it), and confirm whether our support/metrics touch outside CA. Need succinct ops + legal answers before EOD.
sam.sales: They also want an estimated delta in cost for a temporary CA isolation for the trial.

ana.presales: quick note: are they ok with a soft pin for the POC (best-effort regional affinity) or do they require a contractual hard pin that guarantees no cross-region routing? The difference affects SLA & pricing.

sam.sales: They used the word "guarantee" in the RFP. So I think they want hard pin or a contractual attestation.

chris.infra: Current hosted control/control-plane is multi-region with primary in ca-central1 for Canada customers, but telemetry and some control services fall back to us-central for aggregation. Options:
- Option A (fastest): soft_pin + telemetry filter: keep inference payloads in CA, scrub metadata before aggregation, route metrics summary (non-identifying) outside CA. ETA: 2-3 days for POC config.
- Option B (strong): dedicated CA reserved pool + regional control-plane routing + regional KMS (BYOK): inference, logs, and control-plane stay in ca-central1. ETA: ~10-14 days and requires capacity commit.
- Option C (strict): private deployment (customer VPC or on-prem) with our control plane components in their VPC: full residency, longest ETA.

chris.infra: Important tech caveats:
- Short-lived debug sessions and remote support: our support tooling opens ephemeral tunnels that currently route through support-east (us) unless we use Private or regional control-plane. This is a compliance blocker if they forbid any outbound metadata.
- Retention: we can set PoC log retention to 48 hours and redact request-level metadata, but that is a policy + config change.

jo.legal: For the wording: we can provide a CA-only sub-processor attestation for Option B/Private. For Option A we can provide a risk statement and the telemetry redaction configuration but it won't satisfy a strict "no crossing" clause. Also must escalate to privacy counsel if the customer requires deletion of support access logs older than 30 days.

ana.presales: Pricing deltas (very rough estimate for the POC):
- Soft_pin (Option A): no baseline change, small ops fee ($500) for telemetry config.
- Dedicated CA reserved (Option B, 2-week POC): minimum one-week reserved block — pricing uplift ~30% vs hosted for reserved hourly cost + one-time KMS integration ($8k) + short-term capacity commit (~$2k for the POC block).
- Private (Option C): not recommended for a 2-week POC; enterprise quote only.

chris.infra: Example routing snippet we can push as a POc policy (will accept as config in the POC request):

```
tenant_policy:
  affinity:
    region: ca-central1
    mode: hard
    sticky_ttl: 14d
  telemetry:
    redact_request_ids: true
    retain_logs_days: 2
    export_summary_only: true
  kms:
    mode: customer_managed
    region: ca-central1
```

chris.infra: Note: mode: hard requires reserved pool and an ops ticket to create the mapping; sticky_ttl is for tenant stickiness in case of failover. For a true legal "no-cross" we need to set export_summary_only:false and ensure control-plane endpoints are region-scoped (Option B).

troy.sre: From an oncall/support perspective, if we do Option B we need runbook updates: support access will be region-restricted and we may require customer approval for live-session escalation. Also add temporary support windows into the SOC process.

jo.legal: Actionables for contract/RFI: I'll draft a CA sub-processor attestation template and a short addendum that calls out which services remain in CA and which support workflows require explicit authorization. I will also prepare the security questionnaire snippets (answers for SAQ: telemetry, BYOK, incident response, access controls).

sam.sales: Perfect. For tomorrow's FinNova meeting (9am PT) I'll propose Option A as immediate POC with clear note: if they require strict guarantee, Option B needed and timeline/costs apply. Action items: @ana.presales create scoped price + one-page comparison, @chris.infra open capacity request and list exact telemetry endpoints (full FQDNs) we must block/regionally route, @jo.legal produce attestation template and questionnaire answers. I'll send invite.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled for 12 hours prior to meeting (will post in channel).

sam.sales: thanks everyone, please keep replies short in this thread so I can forward to FinNova.
